display_name: 跨接收机身份参照的无更新源梯度剂量诊断
description: 原三E30只读sourceL建立固定身份参照，seed01以12源L/U批测raw/同G/双G关系约束梯度；无optimizer/V/target。
authorization: 继续用户PAMF SSL性能目标；先以不更新参数的合法源诊断验证已公开跨RX身份参照计划。

code.environment: N607 existing CVS-RFFI Python/Torch2.1; FP32/TF32off; no installs

data.dataset: same original F0 VALIDATED_ONCE roles and physical IDs
data.contract_ref: same-contract E20 complete.config.source_contract; private checked context
data.label_map_ref: existing default-head classes: six / ManyRx ten

roles.L_s: all6300 only for frozen references;12x128 original T1 gradients;L2 smoke
roles.U_s: 12x256 hidden-label source batches for primary ordinaryPL and matched relation gradients

data.train_ratio: original L6300/U56700/V27000 roles unchanged;zero optimizer updates
data.validation_ref: existing VALIDATED_ONCE handles, unchanged; Phase1 capsule/split p2 handles not applicable

permissions.claim_scope: preclip source gradient proxy only;no target benefit or U truth accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: three frozen own ordinary-PL E20+10 E30 readers;seed01 disposable strict E30 student;fixed same G-LU
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: load_sources full E20/own10 actual headers,source roles/defaulthead;reuse VALIDATED_ONCE
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: existing original F0 ownE20/E30/G provenance checked at load
checkpoint.selection_rule: all three fixed teachers;no new checkpoint or target selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 only,one own worker,global CUDA+pending<2 at admission,free>=10000MiB,CPU2threads;preserve others
execution.stop_rule: First source provenance/role/feature-smoke/nonfinite/statechange/technical error stops this run only;preserve partials;no automatic retry or healthy owner intervention.

expected_artifacts: all sourceF/G and student parameters/registeredbuffers unchanged

metric_names: original head gradient and no auxiliary head gradient
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: no target or V predictions;private source-L references.pt
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: no truth scoring;hidden-U q comes from raw teachers

rows.config_ref: fixed receiver_reference.py rule and minimal original source context

notes: No sourceV or target reading;no new training or scientific performance claim.
Reference and teacher coordinates are ownseed;no crossseed feature averaging or pseudo/V reference update.
One common dose uses maximum median extra norm across three variants,clarifying the published 10percent rule before observing results.
First sortedRX holdout concerns only extra supervision;E30/main L/raw already saw all sourceRX,not a true unseen-base-RX claim.
Temporary native train buffers restored after each independent measurement,including nonpersistent registered banks.
Future source-transfer training requires separate immutable matrix and original plan scientific rule;this run cannot demonstrate goal completion.

matrix.reference_rule: normalize mean normalized ownE30 L features perTX/RX;exclude ownRX;equal RX contribution
matrix.pseudo: frozen threeE30 raw mean probability;unanimous class and eachconfidence>=.95
matrix.extra_held_RX: first sorted sourceRX;excluded only extra mask;primary remains original L/raw ordinaryPL
matrix.loss_normalization: mask then full U batch mean;average two forwards
matrix.dose_scope: preclip Sinc physicalHz/CENTER_UNITS;not actual AdamW direction
matrix.paired_randomness: same postprimary RNG and buffers restored before each variant;allbuffers restored afterbatch
